title: The Old Key
text:
Tom has a red bag. He finds a small key in the bag. The key is old and gold. He wants to find the box that opens with the key.

Tom looks in the park. He finds a little box under a tree. He opens the box with the key. Inside, there is a letter for him.

questions.text: What does Tom find under a tree?
Why does Tom open the box with the key?
options: He wants to see what is inside
He wants to lose the key

questions.text: How does Tom probably feel when he finds the letter?

vocabulary.definition: a small metal object used to open a lock
a container with four sides, used to hold things
a written message sent to a person

paragraph_translations: Tom'un kırmızı bir çantası var. Çantada küçük bir anahtar buluyor. Anahtar eski ve altın renginde. Anahtarla açılan kutuyu bulmak istiyor.
Tom parkta bakıyor. Bir ağacın altında küçük bir kutu buluyor. Kutuyu anahtarla açıyor. İçinde onun için bir mektup var.
